spec.assertion: buffApply stat 'casterAtkPct' with value === 0.8026 × avistar.staticAtk (flat-resolved), exactly ONE recipient slug across the fight. Fails under CF1 (target re-scoped to all allies → >1 recipient + team total moves) and CF2 (stat encoded as atkPct → wrong stat emitted + board moves).

First casterAtkPct apply frame > first fullBurstStart frame, and no apply frame falls strictly inside any [fullBurstStart, fullBurstEnd] window. Fails under CF3 (re-keyed to fullBurstEnter → first apply lands at/before the first FB start, and totals diverge).

The grant is an out-of-FB-only window: applications occur only on FB-end edges, never renewed mid-Full-Burst. Nearest-wrong (a permanent/continuous grant, or one refreshed at FB-enter) puts an apply inside an FB window.

⚑ Cardinality-only: exactly one recipient, stable across the fight, and NOT avistar's own damage channel (her total is unchanged under CF1). The specific recipient slug is not derivable from the prose — no selector keyword (highest ATK / element / class / weapon / positional) appears — so identity is it.skip'd rather than guessed.

Repeated self-targeted recovery events (heal ticks:10, intervalSec:1): count strictly greater than the FB-end count (proves HoT, not a single instant heal) and ≤ 10× that count; minimum inter-tick gap === 60 frames. Fails under the nearest-wrong single-tick heal (count === edges, no 60-frame spacing) — the taxonomy's TANDEM rule: this is the feed for any teammate's on-recovery trigger.

Cross-line invariant: skill2's gated activations ≤ avistar's own burstCast count. A model leaving Stargazer permanently on (never consumed/removed) over-fires skill2 on Full Bursts she did not re-arm.
it.skip — no HP pool in v1 (boss deals no damage), so the self-cost is unobservable and the '>25% HP' precondition is trivially always-true. Needs an HP-pool primitive.

buffApply stat 'projectileExplosionPct' value 40.13, single recipient. Nearest-wrong merges it into attackDamagePct (silently changes who benefits — projectileExplosionPct is RL-scoped, attackDamagePct universal); asserting BOTH stats exist separately at the same magnitude catches the merge.

buffApply stat 'attackDamagePct' value 40.13, single recipient, applied within 1 frame of a fullBurstStart (trigger = fullBurstEnter, NOT skill1's fullBurstEnd and NOT burstCast). Dropping both buffs (CF4) lowers team damage — load-bearing — while leaving avistar's own total unchanged (ally-scoped inertness).

Non-vacuity for the gate: every skill2 application frame > avistar's first burstCast frame, i.e. the fixture exercises both the gated-OFF case (FBs before she bursts) and the gated-ON case. Nearest-wrong (ungated fullBurstEnter) fires on the pre-burst Full Burst.

reenterStage:1, all allies. Removing it (CF5) must change either the full-burst count or the team total by >1 — a truly inert result would mean the effect is unreachable in this fixture and the whole group is vacuous, which the assertion surfaces.

Self buffApply re-emitted as stat 'maxHpFlat' with value ≈ 0.264 × avistar.maxHp; expiresFrame absent or ≥ fight length and durationShots undefined ('continuously' ⇒ no durationSec — nearest-wrong stamps the 10s FB window). Inertness: removing it (CF6) must NOT move avistar's damage — she carries no atkOfMaxHpPct scaler, so a RED here means either an HP→ATK leak or the Stargazer gate wrongly hung on the HP buff rather than modeled as its own status.

fixtures: controlComp('avistar', true) for every run — Avistar is Burst I, so the control's B2/B3 slots complete the chain and Full Bursts actually occur; every line on this kit hangs off a Full Burst edge (enter or end), so a fixture without real Full Bursts would make the whole file vacuously green (hence the explicit fbStarts/fbEnds > 0 sanity group). Fixed-B3 kept TRUE: her buffs are ally-scoped and read via buffApply events (stat + value + recipient identity), not via a bare damage delta, so the fixed B3's own buffs cannot confound the discriminating assertions. Six hoisted counterfactuals via withPatchedOverride, one per nearest-wrong model: CF1 ally-scope→all-allies, CF2 casterAtkPct→atkPct, CF3 fullBurstEnd→fullBurstEnter, CF4 skill2 buffs dropped (load-bearing check), CF5 reenterStage dropped (rotation shape), CF6 casterMaxHpPct dropped (offensive-inertness check). 7 runComp calls total, well under the ~20-run budget.
gaps: skill2 'Current HP ▼ 20%' self-cost — it.skip: no HP pool modeled in v1 (the boss deals no damage), so both the 20% cost and the '>25% HP' precondition are unobservable and offensively inert. Needs an HP-pool primitive before the gate can discriminate anything.

The identity of the single-ally designator ('her favorite pop star') on skill1 block A and skill2 block B — it.skip: ⚑ the prose carries no mechanical selector (no highest-ATK / element / class / weapon / positional keyword), so the recipient slug is outside the blind input domain. Cardinality (exactly one), stability (same recipient all fight), and non-self-payout ARE asserted; identity must come from in-game targeting or a measurement.

Not a gap but a flagged ⚑ for the reconciling judge: skill1's HoT magnitude (3.52% of final Max HP per tick) is unobservable in a sim with no HP pool — only the recovery EVENT cadence (10 ticks × 1s) is testable, and that is what the assertion pins. The percentage itself cannot be validated by this harness.
